title: A Telegram bot that guides daily pet-video shooting
lead: Leads a non-technical person through daily shooting tasks, assembles a vertical clip with ffmpeg and writes the post text for each platform.
problem: A person with no technical background needs to shoot a video about a pet regularly and publish it on several platforms. The bot does the guiding and the editing; the person publishes.
built: A task script: first-week and second-week tasks, with videos and answers received in the chat.
An ffmpeg edit: vertical format, an 18-second clip at about -14 LUFS.
Post texts for each platform, and a quality check of the clip before it is sent.
A safeguard so a second copy of the bot running by mistake does not break it.
steps: The bot gives the day's task and receives the video.
ffmpeg assembles a vertical 18-second clip at about -14 LUFS.
A quality check catches problems before the clip is sent.
The bot writes a post text per platform; you publish it yourself.
offer: A bot with a day-by-day task script for your use case.
An ffmpeg editing pipeline with a quality check.
price_en: On request, after a short brief
